# trypanic/go-sdk

> Opinionated Go SDK for distributed systems. Bundles structured logging, classified errors, OpenTelemetry tracing, retrying HTTP client, RabbitMQ messaging, and Postgres/Mongo/storage primitives behind a small, explicit API surface.

Module path: `github.com/trypanic/go-sdk`; language floor Go `1.26.1`, with supported patched toolchains documented in README. The audit's later dependency phase applies `/v2`. SDK-classified operations return AppError values; upstream APIs, callbacks and documented lifecycle methods can return other errors. Default HTTP/LLM/Mongo constructors trace; explicit instrumenters or no-tracing constructors control this. User interaction is Spanish; technical artifacts are English.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, package map (directory vs. package identifier), status table, compatibility (semver, supported toolchains), developer setup, quality gates
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md): operational guide for AI agents — package selection, conventions, anti-patterns, canonical bootstrap
- [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release notes generated by release-please from Conventional Commits, one entry per version (starts after v1.0.0)
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local gates, commit conventions, pull request checks
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/SECURITY.md): vulnerability reporting (GitHub private reporting), supported versions and toolchains, advisory triage; static-analysis runner contract, env knobs, semgrep rule promotion

## Packages

- [errorkit](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/errorkit/README.md): classified errors with identity, metadata, safe PublicJSON, chain helpers and optional stackless creation
- [logger](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/logger/README.md): zerolog wrapper, redaction and trace correlation, `ErrorCtx` / `LogInfoWithTrace` helpers
- [telemetry](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/telemetry/README.md): OTel span factory with consistent naming (`Job`, `Batch`, `External`, `Messaging`, `DB`); `Instrumenter` is the standard tracing handle
- [httpclient](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/httpclient/README.md): production-tuned `*http.Client` factory with shared pool, redirect policy, opt-in transport wrappers (e.g. `otelhttp`)
- [httprequest](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/httprequest/README.md): retrying outbound HTTP with exponential backoff, status→errorkit mapping, body redaction, audit log
- [httpserver](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/httpserver/README.md): framework-agnostic server contracts; only Hertz adapter shipped under `httpserver/hertz/`
- [grpc](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/grpc/README.md): google.golang.org/grpc server + client factories, four call modes, OTel tracing, recovery, ToStatus/FromStatus; register standard generated services
- [postgres](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/postgres/README.md): pgx pool, generic `StoredProcedure[T]` helper with explicit instrumenter wrapping
- [mongo](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/mongo/README.md): mongo-driver wrapper with the standard tracing constructor triplet
- [messaging](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/messaging/README.md): RabbitMQ pub/sub, declarative topology loader (`RABBITMQ_TOPOLOGY_FILE`), reconnection backoff
- [storage](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/storage/README.md): KV + append-only log generic store with file and in-memory backends
- [llmclient](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/llmclient/README.md): OpenAI-compatible chat client, non-streaming, built on top of `httprequest`
- [envs](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/envs/README.md): typed env loader, thin wrapper around `caarlos0/env`
- [marshal](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/marshal/README.md): JSON encoding helpers
- [stringutils](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/stringutils/README.md): string normalization and markdown stripping
- [urlkit](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/urlkit/README.md): URL build and path join helpers
- [validators](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/validators/README.md): date, alphanumeric string and integer-range validators; expected failures omit stacks
- [batch](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/batch/README.md): bounded chunks and stable deduplication
- [algorithms](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/algorithms/README.md): exponential backoff factory for custom retry loops

- [logger/otlp](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/logger/otlp/README.md): explicit Writer and TLS Provider lifecycle; base logger does not import gRPC
- [httpservertest](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/httpserver/httpservertest/README.md): handler recorder with response and Err inspection
- [mongotest](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/mongo/mongotest/README.md): callback-based client, collection, cursor and result fakes
- [messagingtest](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/messaging/messagingtest/README.md): callback-based Broker fake
- [ioutils](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/ioutils/README.md): dev-only JSON dumps; excluded from production paths
- [v2 API migration](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/docs/v2-api-migration.md): exact package, type, constructor and span-name changes

## Conventions

- [Tracing constructor triplet](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md#22-tracing): `New`, `NewWithoutTracing`, `NewWithInstrumenter`. Exceptions: `postgres` traces at `StoredProcedure` layer; `messaging` and gRPC accept instrumenters or existing tracer/provider options; Hertz uses the global provider.
- [Error wrapping rules](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md#4-idiomatic-error-handling): wrap once at boundaries, preserve original `ErrorCode`, never double-wrap an `*AppError` with `ERR_INTERNAL`.
- Retry metadata is combined with HTTP idempotency rules; plain POST/PATCH requests are not replayed after uncertain delivery. Context constructors bound setup without taking lifecycle ownership. Borrowed Mongo drivers remain caller-owned.
- [Body redaction](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/httprequest/README.md): bodies redacted by default in error payloads and audit logs; `WithRawBodies()` is dev-only.
- [Built-in error codes](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/errorkit/README.md#built-in-error-codes-reference): full reference table with HTTP status and retriability per code.

## Optional

- [Anti-patterns](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md#5-anti-patterns-do-not-write-this-code): mistakes to avoid when consuming the SDK
- [Canonical bootstrap](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/AGENTS.md#3-canonical-service-bootstrap): wire-up template for a new service using logging + tracing + HTTP + Postgres + RabbitMQ
- [Quality gates](https://github.com/trypanic/go-sdk/blob/main/README.md#quality-gates): `go test -short ./...`, `task staticanalysis`, `task precommit:run`, `task deps:update`
